meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能调用你电脑上通过 Ollama 运行的本地模型来回答或处理任务,例如列出已装模型、让指定模型生成文字;若开启管理开关,还能下载、删除模型及查看运行状态。
howto.when: 当用户要求把本机 Ollama 模型接入 Claude 或添加 Ollama 工具时触发;若检测到已安装则跳过,否则完成复制、注册和配置。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型,再让模型回答。
开始从 Ollama 仓库下载该模型。

say.text: 哪些 Ollama 模型正在内存中运行?
say.note: 列出已加载模型及内存占用。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can call local models served by Ollama on your machine to answer questions or handle tasks, e.g. list installed models or have a model generate text. If management tools are enabled, it can also pull/delete models and check running ones.
howto.when_en: The skill triggers when you ask to integrate local Ollama models with Claude or add the Ollama tool. It checks if already applied; if not, it copies files, registers the server, and configures env vars.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models then generates a response.
Downloads a model from the Ollama registry.

say_en.text: Which ollama models are currently loaded in memory?
say_en.note: Lists loaded models with memory usage.
